title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“无极老儿，快把你那孽徒带走！老夫这株九转金莲可是培育了三千年，全被他毁了！”仙药峰上，一位白发老者吹胡子瞪眼，唾沫星子直溅无极仙帝一脸。无极仙帝无奈地抹了把脸，心中将自家那不成器的徒弟狠狠咒骂了一通。“无极老头，你今日必须给我一个交代！”一位风韵犹存的美妇从空中飘然而落，柳眉倒竖，眼中怒火熊熊。“柳宫主，何故如此大动肝火？”无极仙帝满心无奈，不用想都知道又是自家那孽徒惹的祸，于是又在心里将那孽徒痛骂了一遍。惹谁不好？非要去招惹梨花仙宫。这梨花仙宫全是女修，打不得，道理也没法讲。“这得问你家那个好徒儿，昨天偷偷潜入我梨花仙宫，还溜进弟子沐浴的浴池……”柳宫主说到这里顿了顿，脸色微红，她紧咬银牙，腮边微微鼓起，那愤怒的模样仿佛让周围的空气都凝固了。无极仙帝再次在心里将叶辰狠狠骂了个百八十遍。“无极老头，你那徒儿叶辰，竟然绑架我宗圣女，勒索了一百万上品灵石，今日你必须给我一个说法。”又一位风韵犹存的中年美妇飞身跃上仙药峰，手指无极仙帝，怒气冲冲地说道。“苏宗主，还有这事？其中是不是有什么误会？”无极仙帝无奈赔笑，明知故问。“哼！没有误会，我宗圣女只是在人群之中多看了叶辰一眼，你那徒儿硬说我宗圣女觊觎他的美色，声称自己的心灵受到了伤害，绑架我宗圣女索要赔偿。”苏宗主气得直跺脚。无极仙帝哑口无言，嘴角忍不住抽搐，这孽徒的脸皮还真是厚到了极点。这已经是他这个月接到的第八百六十四起投诉了，原因毫无例外，都是他那宝贝徒弟叶辰干的荒唐事。偷仙药、看仙女洗澡、绑架勒索……就没有这小子不敢干的！偏偏他还天赋异禀，年仅十五岁便踏入炼虚境。背后又有整个无极仙宫撑腰，搞得仙界各大宗门虽敢怒却不敢言，只能纷纷跑到他这里告状。“诸位稍安勿躁，待我将那逆徒寻回，定会给各位一个交代！”无极仙帝一边陪着笑脸，一边在心里盘算着怎么把叶辰那小子抓回来。“师父，您老找我？”就在这时，一道欠揍的声音从大殿外传来。只见叶辰身着一身白色锦袍，手摇折扇，一副翩翩佳公子的模样，晃晃悠悠地走了进来。“逆徒！你还敢回来！”无极仙帝气得胡子都翘了起来，指着叶辰的鼻子大骂道。“你可知你都干了些什么好事！整个仙界都被你搅得不得安宁！”叶辰不以为意地掏了掏耳朵，“师父，您这话可说错了，我一直都在做好事啊！怎么就搅得不得安宁了？”“无极，你今日若是不给我们一个交代，我们就去天帝那里告状！”“就是！必须要严惩叶尘，否则我等誓不罢休！”“你徒弟将我的坐骑大鹏鸟吃了，你今日必须赔偿给我！”听到叶辰这番不知悔改的话语，在场告状之人皆是怒不可遏，纷纷出声指责叶辰的恶行。大殿外，各宗门掌教、长老的声音此起彼伏，声势浩大，震得整个无极仙宫都嗡嗡作响。“哎！你们怎么能错怪好人呢？我都是在做好事，助人为乐啊！”叶辰摇摇头，摆出一副无辜又委屈的模样。

前来告状的众人看着叶辰这委屈巴巴的模样都愣住了，等着叶辰的下文。“清风老头，你的九转金莲在药田三千年了，都要烂在药田了，我帮你收起来，你不感谢我还来指责我。”叶辰手指老者，痛心疾首地说道。“还有你。我是看你们梨花仙宫都是女弟子，心灵缺少安慰，我好心想去安慰一下她们的心灵。”叶辰转头看向柳宫主，说完又补充道。“谁知道走错了路，误入浴池，我也不知道你们梨花仙宫弟子洗澡不穿衣服的，我只看了一眼，她们又没有什么损失，也没少块肉！”“还有你苏宗主，你们圣女贪图我的美色我都无所谓了，我还看你们圣女一个人在外不安全，我好心护送她回家向你们要点路费不过分吧！”“还有你们……”……叶辰巧舌如簧，一口气将所有的告状都狡辩了一番。一时间，这些前来告状之人被叶辰无耻的狡辩怼得哑口无言。“师傅，你看，我做的都是好事，助人为乐，她们都无话可说了！”叶辰双手一摊，脸上露出得意洋洋的表情。“你……”无极仙帝被他气得差点一口气没喘上来，指着叶辰的手指颤抖不停。哪怕他的脸皮这几年已经被叶辰锻炼得够厚了，此刻听了叶辰的狡辩也是彻底绷不住了。无极仙帝深吸一口气，强压下心中的怒火，转头对着叶辰说道：“孽徒！今日为师便将你逐出师门，贬下凡间，没有我的命令，你永远不许踏入仙界半步！”“啊！师父，不是吧！弟子做了这么多好事你还要惩罚我！这没天理啊！”叶辰一听要被贬下凡间，顿时慌了神，连忙狡辩。然而，无极仙帝心意已决，大手一挥，直接将叶辰的修为封印，然后一脚将他踹下了云端。“啊……死老头，你来真的！”叶辰发出一声惨叫，嘴里骂骂咧咧地化作一道流光，消失在天际。……苍兰界，也叫苍兰大陆，天玄宗。此时，天玄宗正在招收新弟子，山门广场上人山人海，正在排队检测资质。“轰隆！”一声巨响，天玄宗的大门被什么东西砸得稀巴烂，地上还砸出一个大坑，木屑飞溅，尘土飞扬。“什么人，竟敢擅闯我天玄宗！”守门的弟子见状，顿时怒不可遏，拔剑冲了上去。守门弟子定睛一看，只见一个身穿白色锦袍的俊美青年，正四仰八叉地躺在大坑中，一脸茫然。“你是什么人？为何擅闯我天玄宗！”一长相阴郁的筑基期青年弟子厉声喝问，手中长剑直指叶辰。他叫焦候庚，是天玄宗大长老的亲传弟子，实际上是大长老的私生子。也是天玄宗第一天才，年仅十八岁便突破筑基期，在整个苍兰大陆都非常少见。导致他自视清高，嚣张跋扈，横行霸道，且睚眦必报。ps:感谢各位看官能看到小编的作品，愿各位看官身体健康，大富大贵，全家欢乐。创作不易，小编不能写到每个人都喜欢我的作品，还望各位不喜欢的看官大人多多包容，少给几个差评，小编在这里拜谢了。
content_en:
"Old Wuji, take that evil disciple of yours away quickly! I have been cultivating this Nine-turn Golden Lotus for three thousand years, but he destroyed it all!" On the Immortal Medicine Peak, a white-haired old man blew his beard and glared, spittle splashing directly into Immortal Emperor Wuji's face.Immortal Emperor Wuji wiped his face helplessly and cursed his incompetent disciple in his heart."Old man Wuji, you must give me an explanation today!" A beautiful woman who still retains her charm floated down from the sky, her eyebrows were raised, and her eyes were blazing with anger."Palace Master Liu, why are you so angry?" Immortal Emperor Wuji was helpless. He knew without even thinking that it was his evil disciple who caused the trouble again, so he scolded that evil disciple again in his heart.Who is bad to mess with?He must provoke Lihua Xiangong.This Lihua Immortal Palace is full of female cultivators, so they can't fight, and there's no way to reason."You have to ask your good disciple. Yesterday he sneaked into our Lihua Fairy Palace and slipped into the bathhouse where his disciples were bathing..." Palace Master Liu paused here, her face turned red. She gritted her silver teeth, her cheeks bulged slightly, and her angry look seemed to freeze the air around her.Immortal Emperor Wuji once again scolded Ye Chen a hundred and eighty times in his heart."Old man Wuji, your disciple Ye Chen actually kidnapped my sect's saint daughter and extorted one million high-grade spiritual stones. Today you must give me an explanation." Another middle-aged beautiful woman who still retains her charm flew up to the Immortal Medicine Peak, pointed at the Wuji Immortal Emperor, and said angrily."Sect Master Su, is there still this matter? Is there any misunderstanding?" Immortal Emperor Wuji had no choice but to apologize and asked knowingly."Hmph! There is no misunderstanding. The saint of our sect just glanced at Ye Chen one more time in the crowd. Your disciple insisted that the saint of our sect coveted his beauty, claimed that his soul was hurt, and kidnapped the saint of our sect to demand compensation." Sect Master Su stomped his feet in anger.Immortal Emperor Wuji was speechless, and the corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch. This evil disciple was really extremely thick-skinned.This is already the 864th complaint he has received this month, and without exception, the reasons are all ridiculous things done by his precious apprentice Ye Chen.Stealing fairy medicine, watching fairies take a bath, kidnapping and extorting... there's nothing this kid wouldn't dare to do!It just so happened that he was extremely talented and entered the Void Refining Realm at the age of only fifteen.With the support of the entire Wuji Immortal Palace behind him, all the major sects in the Immortal Realm dared to be angry but did not dare to speak out, so they could only come to him to complain."Everyone, please be patient. When I find that traitor, I will definitely give you an explanation!" Immortal Emperor Wuji kept smiling while thinking about how to catch Ye Chen back."Master, are you always looking for me?" At this moment, a sound of being beaten came from outside the hall.Ye Chen was seen walking in wearing a white brocade robe, holding a folding fan, looking like a handsome young man."Traitor! How dare you come back!" Immortal Emperor Wuji was so angry that his beard stood up, and he pointed at Ye Chen's nose and cursed."Do you know what good things you have done! The whole fairy world has been disturbed by you!" Ye Chen dug his ears indifferently, "Master, what you said is wrong, I have always done good things! Why can't you disturb the peace?" "Wuji, if you don't give us an explanation today, we willGo to the Emperor of Heaven and complain!" "Yes!Ye Chen must be severely punished, otherwise we will not give up!" "Your apprentice ate my mount, you must pay me for it today!" After hearing Ye Chen's unrepentant words, everyone present was furious and accused Ye Chen of his evil deeds.Outside the main hall, the voices of the heads and elders of various sects echoed one after another. The sound was so loud that it made the entire Wuji Immortal Palace buzz."Hey! How can you wrongly accuse a good person? I am always doing good things and helping others!" Ye Chen shook his head, pretending to be innocent and aggrieved.

Everyone who came to complain was stunned when they saw Ye Chen's aggrieved look, waiting for Ye Chen's next words."Old man Qingfeng, your Nine-turn Golden Lotus has been in the medicine field for three thousand years and it is about to rot in the medicine field. I will help you put it away. If you don't thank me, you will accuse me." Ye Chen pointed at the old man and said sadly."And you. I see that you, Lihua Immortal Palace, are all female disciples and lack comfort in their souls. I kindly want to comfort their souls." Ye Chen turned to look at Palace Master Liu, and then added after speaking."Who knew that I took the wrong road and entered the bathing pool by mistake? I didn't know that you disciples of Lihua Fairy Palace bathed without clothes. I only took a look at them. They didn't lose anything and they didn't lose any meat!" "And you, Sect Master Su, you saints covet my beauty.It doesn't matter to me anymore. I think it's not safe for you Saint to be alone outside.It's not too much for me to kindly escort her home and ask for travel expenses from you!" "And you..."... Ye Chen was eloquent and quibbled with all the complaints in one breath.For a moment, these people who came to complain were rendered speechless by Ye Chen's shameless sophistry."Master, look, I do good things and help others, and they have nothing to say!" Ye Chen spread his hands with a triumphant expression on his face."You..." Immortal Emperor Wuji was so angry that he almost couldn't breathe, and his fingers pointing at Ye Chen were trembling.Even though his face had been tempered by Ye Chen in recent years, he couldn't stand it anymore after hearing Ye Chen's sophistry.Immortal Emperor Wuji took a deep breath, suppressed the anger in his heart, turned to Ye Chen and said: "Evil disciple! Today, as my master, I will expel you from the master and demote you to the mortal world. Without my order, you will never step into the immortal world!" "Ah! Master, no! You have done so many good things and you still punish me! This is unreasonable!" When Ye Chen heard that he was going to be demoted to the mortal world, he immediately panicked and quibbled.However, Immortal Emperor Wuji had made up his mind, and with a wave of his hand, he directly sealed Ye Chen's cultivation, and then kicked him off the cloud."Ah... damn old man, are you serious!" Ye Chen let out a scream, cursing in his mouth and turned into a stream of light, disappearing into the sky....Canglan Realm, also called Canglan Continent, Tianxuan Sect.At this time, Tianxuan Sect was recruiting new disciples, and the mountain gate square was crowded with people queuing up to test their qualifications."Boom!" There was a loud noise, and the door of Tianxuan Sect was smashed to pieces by something. A big hole was made on the ground, sawdust flew, and dust flew up."Who dares to trespass into our Tianxuan Sect!" Upon seeing this, the disciple guarding the gate became furious and rushed forward with his sword drawn.The gatekeeper took a closer look and saw a handsome young man wearing a white brocade robe, lying in the pit with his back stretched out, a look of confusion on his face."Who are you? Why are you trespassing on our Tianxuan Sect!" A gloomy-looking young disciple in the Foundation Establishment Stage asked sternly, pointing the long sword in his hand at Ye Chen.His name is Jiao Hougeng, and he is a direct disciple of the great elder of Tianxuan Sect. He is actually the illegitimate son of the great elder.He is also the number one genius in the Tianxuan Sect. He broke through the foundation building stage at the age of only eighteen, which is very rare in the entire Canlan Continent.As a result, he views himself as noble, arrogant and domineering, and is domineering and unyielding.ps: Thank you all for reading my work. I wish you good health, great wealth, and happiness for your whole family.Creation is not easy, and I cannot write that everyone likes my work. I hope that readers who don’t like it will be more tolerant and give less bad reviews. I would like to thank you here.

前来告状的众人看着叶辰这委屈巴巴的模样都愣住了，等着叶辰的下文。“清风老头，你的九转金莲在药田三千年了，都要烂在药田了，我帮你收起来，你不感谢我还来指责我。”叶辰手指老者，痛心疾首地说道。“还有你。我是看你们梨花仙宫都是女弟子，心灵缺少安慰，我好心想去安慰一下她们的心灵。”叶辰转头看向柳宫主，说完又补充道。“谁知道走错了路，误入浴池，我也不知道你们梨花仙宫弟子洗澡不穿衣服的，我只看了一眼，她们又没有什么损失，也没少块肉！”“还有你苏宗主，你们圣女贪图我的美色我都无所谓了，我还看你们圣女一个人在外不安全，我好心护送她回家向你们要点路费不过分吧！”“还有你们……”……叶辰巧舌如簧，一口气将所有的告状都狡辩了一番。一时间，这些前来告状之人被叶辰无耻的狡辩怼得哑口无言。“师傅，你看，我做的都是好事，助人为乐，她们都无话可说了！”叶辰双手一摊，脸上露出得意洋洋的表情。“你……”无极仙帝被他气得差点一口气没喘上来，指着叶辰的手指颤抖不停。哪怕他的脸皮这几年已经被叶辰锻炼得够厚了，此刻听了叶辰的狡辩也是彻底绷不住了。无极仙帝深吸一口气，强压下心中的怒火，转头对着叶辰说道：“孽徒！今日为师便将你逐出师门，贬下凡间，没有我的命令，你永远不许踏入仙界半步！”“啊！师父，不是吧！弟子做了这么多好事你还要惩罚我！这没天理啊！”叶辰一听要被贬下凡间，顿时慌了神，连忙狡辩。然而，无极仙帝心意已决，大手一挥，直接将叶辰的修为封印，然后一脚将他踹下了云端。“啊……死老头，你来真的！”叶辰发出一声惨叫，嘴里骂骂咧咧地化作一道流光，消失在天际。……苍兰界，也叫苍兰大陆，天玄宗。此时，天玄宗正在招收新弟子，山门广场上人山人海，正在排队检测资质。“轰隆！”一声巨响，天玄宗的大门被什么东西砸得稀巴烂，地上还砸出一个大坑，木屑飞溅，尘土飞扬。“什么人，竟敢擅闯我天玄宗！”守门的弟子见状，顿时怒不可遏，拔剑冲了上去。守门弟子定睛一看，只见一个身穿白色锦袍的俊美青年，正四仰八叉地躺在大坑中，一脸茫然。“你是什么人？为何擅闯我天玄宗！”一长相阴郁的筑基期青年弟子厉声喝问，手中长剑直指叶辰。他叫焦候庚，是天玄宗大长老的亲传弟子，实际上是大长老的私生子。也是天玄宗第一天才，年仅十八岁便突破筑基期，在整个苍兰大陆都非常少见。导致他自视清高，嚣张跋扈，横行霸道，且睚眦必报。ps:感谢各位看官能看到小编的作品，愿各位看官身体健康，大富大贵，全家欢乐。创作不易，小编不能写到每个人都喜欢我的作品，还望各位不喜欢的看官大人多多包容，少给几个差评，小编在这里拜谢了。
